argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Where-Object { $_.LocalAddress -in @('127.0.0.1','::1','0.0.0.0') } | Select-Object -First 80 LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { $p=Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [pscustomobject]@{Address=$_.LocalAddress;Port=$_.LocalPort;Pid=$_.OwningProcess;Process=if($p){$p.ProcessName}else{'?'}} } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

note: Read-only bounded listener inventory to locate live bridge without reading secrets
